notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around a standard timestamped interaction retraction callback. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies timestamped interaction delivery and retraction, suppression and release of the request-retraction callback, exact interaction and retraction-handle metadata, callback ordering, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with publishInteractionClass/sendInteraction(time)/retract and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction(time)/requestRetraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and timestamped interaction retraction declarations
